in_marathi.name: Idhika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Idhika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Idhika is derived from the Sanskrit root idh, which means 'desire' or 'intention'. In Hindu mythology, the name Idhika is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and creativity. Idhika represents the inner drive and motivation to pursue knowledge and wisdom.
